title: AgSpec: Pushing the Limits of Retrieval-Based Speculative Decoding in Coding Agent Pipelines
selection_reason: Directly in scope: the paper develops a training-free retrieval-based speculative decoding framework for LLM inference in coding-agent pipelines, addressing corpus coverage/matchability and draft-length control. It evaluates decoding throughput and accepted length against autoregressive decoding and speculative-decoding baselines.
